newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ASC raises St George merger concern.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ASC raises St George merger concern.

text.p: Industry regulator the Australian Securities Commission (ASC) said on Thursday it was concerned about parts of St George Bank Ltd takeover documents for Advance Bank Australia Ltd.
"I think what really caught our attention was the proxy votes," a spokeswoman for the ASC told Reuters.
She said Advance shareholders who did not send in their proxy vote were counted as a 'yes' vote in favour of the deal.
Advance shareholders are due to vote on the A$2.65 billion deal on Monday. She said the ASC may make a comment on the merger before Christmas, but it was more likely to be next year.
